oneParagraphVerdict: This is a strong, shippable-in-spirit chapter with a clear core move: do not ask the cautious middle to supply proof that first believers have not yet created. The summaries layer well, the main examples are anchored, and the limits around TiVo and public scale are honest. I would not ship it against a strict professional bar yet because the quiz has some guessable answer design and Q9 uses sloppy wording, while a couple of transfer examples feel generated rather than observed. The fixes are contained: sharpen the weak quiz language and replace the thinnest examples with before-to-after cases that include a real decision and consequence.
